issue.title: bob ref search: library-wide annotation search across ref notes

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add library-wide annotation search to `bob ref` (for example `bob ref search <TERMS>`): find highlights, comments, and standalone notes across every ref note, returning matching annotations with their note, page label, quote/comment split, and block link, in the same human/Markdown/JSON (`REF_SCHEMA_VERSION`) envelope as `find`/`list`/`show`. Proposed by phase bob-cli-4w.11 (note #4) of epic bob-cli-4w, recorded by bob-cli-4w.land.

Today an agent or Bryan can read one reference's annotations with `bob ref show <REF> -c`, but there is no way to ask "where did I comment on X?" across the library. The building blocks exist: `src/native/highlights_ref/region.rs` (`parse_managed_region`, `split_note_body`) already separates quote from comment and excludes leaked marker mirrors, preamble blocks, and tombstones, and `src/native/ref_library` builds one read-only row per note in ~35 ms on the real vault (594 notes).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-4w's plan explicitly puts "Library-wide annotation search" out of scope; it shipped only find/list/show. Search needs its own design for matching, ranking, and output size.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-4w.11 proposed it as a follow-up; epic bob-cli-4w shipped single-reference annotation reads (bob ref show) but scoped library-wide search out.
